2. Consumers and business customers

These terms apply to goods purchased at smerch.dk. You are a consumer when acting mainly outside your trade or profession. 3. Orders and formation of the contract

Check the product, variant, quantity, decoration, delivery details and price before ordering. You can correct them before placing an order with an obligation to pay. An automated receipt is not itself acceptance. The contract is formed when we expressly accept your order in an order confirmation. If we cannot accept it, we notify you promptly and release any reservation or refund any payment.

After the contract is formed, changes to goods, price or other agreed terms require your agreement. Obvious errors are treated under the ordinary rules of Danish law; there is no general right for us to cancel any order because of a pricing error. The applicable terms accompany the order confirmation in a format you can retain.

4. Prices and payment

Prices are in Danish kroner including VAT unless explicitly marked otherwise. Printing, setup, surcharges and delivery are included in the total disclosed before the binding order. Price examples apply only to the quantities and decoration stated. Additional services and changes require a separate agreement.

Available payment methods are shown at payment. Our payment provider processes payment, and the amount may be reserved when ordering. For standard goods, payment is captured no earlier than dispatch.

For goods made or personalised for you, we may separately agree to payment after your approval of the production proof and before production. This must be clearly disclosed and separately accepted before purchase; accepting these general terms alone is insufficient. Without that agreement, payment is captured no earlier than dispatch. Renewing a reservation does not result in duplicate payment.

5. Artwork and rights

You must have the rights to the logos, images, text, names and other content you submit. You authorise us and the production suppliers involved to use it as necessary to fulfil the order. Ownership is not transferred. Using your artwork in our marketing requires a separate agreement.

You are responsible for file content and compliance with stated file requirements. File checks concern technical suitability, not legal rights or proofreading, unless separately agreed. We contact you about problems we identify that require changes. Additional graphic work is charged only when its scope and price are agreed.

6. Mockups and proof approval

The webshop mockup is indicative. The final production proof shows the design to approve before production. Check spelling, text, logo, variant, printing method, position, dimensions and colour references. Screen colours can differ from physical print. A specific colour match must be agreed using an appropriate colour reference or sample.

By expressly approving a particular proof version, you accept the design details and errors clearly visible in it. We remain responsible for production errors and conformity with the contract. Approval does not remove rights concerning hidden defects or deviations from the approved design. Silence is not approval.

Relevant colour, position, size or quantity tolerances must be specified and included in the agreement. There is no blanket acceptance of every minor deviation. Changes after approval require our written agreement and may affect price and delivery time.

7. Delivery

Standard online checkout delivers to Denmark. Other destinations require agreement. Delivery cost and estimated delivery time are disclosed before purchase, including how proof approval affects custom production. Tell us before ordering if a particular date is essential; a binding deadline must be included in the agreement.

Consumer orders are delivered without undue delay and within 30 days of the contract unless another period is agreed. Statutory remedies for delay, including an appropriate additional deadline and termination, apply. We notify you of delays we become aware of. Supplier or production difficulties do not remove mandatory consumer rights.

For consumers, we bear the risk until you or your designated recipient other than the carrier receives the goods, subject to the statutory exception for a carrier independently chosen by you that we did not offer. Please report visible transport damage promptly, preferably with photos; inspection upon delivery is not a condition of statutory remedies.

8. Changes and cancellation

Contact us promptly to request changes or cancellation. Orders without a statutory withdrawal right have no voluntary cancellation right. Any cancellation requires written agreement, including payment for completed work and unavoidable costs. We do not charge an arbitrary standard cancellation fee. Statutory consumer rights concerning withdrawal, delay and defects are unaffected.

9. Consumer withdrawal rights

For distance purchases of standard goods, consumers have 14 days to withdraw, starting when you or your designated recipient receives the goods. For one order delivered separately, the period starts on receipt of the last item. Notify us clearly before the deadline, for example at hello@smerch.dk. You may use Withdraw from contract or the model form below; neither is compulsory. Simply failing to collect a parcel is insufficient.

Return goods within 14 days of notifying us to Trykeksperten ApS, Raffinaderivej 10e, 2300 København S, Denmark. You pay the direct return cost and bear the return transit risk. For goods not normally returnable by post, the return cost must be disclosed before purchase. No return authorisation number is required to exercise this right.

You may examine goods as you would in a shop. You are liable only for diminished value caused by handling beyond what is needed to establish their nature, characteristics and functioning, and only if the required information was provided. Original packaging is not a general condition of withdrawal; missing packaging may affect a specific diminished-value assessment.

We refund within 14 days of your notice but may withhold repayment until we receive the goods or evidence of dispatch, whichever occurs first. Withdrawal from the whole purchase includes reimbursement of our cheapest offered standard delivery. Extra costs for a more expensive delivery method are not refunded. Repayment uses the original payment method unless expressly agreed otherwise without cost to you. No additional voluntary return or exchange right is offered.

10. Personalised goods

Withdrawal does not apply to goods made to your specifications or clearly personalised, such as goods bearing your own logo, name, text or individual design. We offer no voluntary return or exchange right for these goods. After proof approval, changes or cancellation require our written acceptance. Statutory remedies for defects or delay remain unaffected. Where the legal requirements for the exception are met, it applies from contract formation, even before proof approval or production, and is disclosed before ordering.

Choosing an ordinary stock colour or size, or our ordering a standard item from a supplier, does not automatically make it personalised. Mixed orders are assessed item by item. The withdrawal exception does not remove rights concerning defects.

11. Consumer complaints about defects

The Danish Sale of Goods Act applies, normally with a two-year complaint period from delivery. Statutory extensions or new periods following repair or replacement also apply. Complain within a reasonable time after discovering a defect; notification within two months is always timely.

Contact hello@smerch.dk with order details and a description, preferably with photos. Subject to statutory conditions, remedies include repair, replacement, a price reduction or termination and any applicable damages. A justified remedy is free, including necessary transport. Normal wear, misuse and damage caused by you are not in themselves defects for which we are liable.

Smerch gives no separate commercial guarantee unless expressly stated for the product. Any manufacturer's guarantee applies on its own terms without reducing statutory rights against us.

12. Complaints

Contact us first. If we cannot resolve a consumer complaint, you may, subject to eligibility and financial limits, use Mæglingsteamet for Forbrugerklager at Nævnenes Hus, Toldboden 2, 8800 Viborg, Denmark, and subsequently Forbrugerklagenævnet where applicable. See Nævnenes Hus.

13. Business purchases only

This section replaces sections 9 and 11 for business purchases and takes precedence over conflicting provisions where law permits.

  • No voluntary return or withdrawal. Changes and cancellation require written agreement.
  • Inspection and deadlines. Inspect promptly on receipt. Notify visible defects, shortages or incorrect goods in writing without undue delay and within eight days of delivery; notify hidden defects without undue delay and within eight days of discovery. No remedy may be claimed for defects discovered more than six months after delivery, except where mandatory law, an express guarantee or circumstances that cannot validly be limited require otherwise.
  • Proof and tolerances. You are responsible for the approved content and design, including spelling, graphics, colour choices, dimensions and position. Minor differences in colour tone, size and position between digital proof and physical goods are accepted where inherent in the agreed printing method and material. Exact colour matching to previous orders is not guaranteed. Specifically agreed references, dimensions and tolerances take precedence. Material deviations or a different design are not covered by this reservation.
  • Production defects. For justified defects we choose free replacement of the defective goods to the agreed address or a credit for their invoice value. Amounts already paid and credited are refunded; you need not accept a voucher. We are not obliged to repair. Keep goods available for inspection, provide relevant evidence and return them as instructed. We pay necessary return costs for justified complaints. Failure to cooperate may invalidate a claim if it prevents us from establishing whether it is justified. Non-excludable rights remain unaffected.
  • Liability. Liability for defects is limited to the replacement or credit described above. Further damages arising from defects, including business interruption, lost profit and goodwill, are excluded. These limitations do not apply to intent or gross negligence, personal injury or liability that cannot lawfully be limited, including mandatory product liability.
  • Exceptional obstacles. We are not liable in damages for delay caused by exceptional circumstances outside our reasonable control that could not be foreseen or avoided when contracting. We notify you and mitigate consequences. A supplier problem alone is insufficient. This does not entitle us to retain payment for undelivered goods following valid termination.

14. Governing law and changes

Danish law applies. Consumers retain mandatory protection and legally available courts. Business disputes are heard by the ordinary Danish courts at the seller's domicile. Revised terms apply only to future purchases. Individually agreed lawful terms take precedence.
